title: Unit 2 Mixed Review Review Test
description: Reinforce the essential Unit 2 connections from dilations and similarity to slope.

questions.questionText: A point (3, 4) is dilated from the origin by scale factor 2. What is the image point?
questions.explanation: A dilation from the origin multiplies both coordinates by 2.

questions.questionText: A point (1, 5) is dilated from the origin by scale factor 3. What is the image point?
questions.explanation: A dilation from the origin multiplies both coordinates by 3.

questions.questionText: Two similar figures have corresponding sides 4 and 8. A matching side on the first figure is 6. What is the side on the second figure?
options: 10 units
3 units
14 units
12 units
questions.explanation: The scale factor is 8 / 4 = 2. Multiply 6 by 2.

questions.questionText: Figure A has side lengths 3 and 5. Figure B has corresponding side lengths 6 and 10. What can you conclude?
options: The figures must be congruent.
The figures cannot be similar because the sides differ.
The side ratios are consistent, so this supports similarity.
Only the longer sides matter.
questions.correctAnswer: The side ratios are consistent, so this supports similarity.
questions.explanation: Compare matching ratios: 3/6 and 5/10. Similar figures need one consistent scale relationship.

questions.questionText: Triangle R has angles 40 degrees and 70 degrees. Triangle S has angles 70 degrees and 70 degrees. Which statement is best?
options: The triangles are similar by AA.
The triangles are congruent by AA.
The triangles are similar only if their side lengths are equal.
The triangles are not similar because one angle is hidden.
questions.correctAnswer: The triangles are similar by AA.
questions.explanation: The missing angles are 70 degrees and 40 degrees. AA needs two matching angle pairs.

questions.questionText: One slope triangle has rise 2 and run 3. Another has rise 4 and run 6. What does this show?
options: The larger triangle is always steeper.
The triangles have the same rise/run ratio, so they can represent the same line slope.
The slope is found by adding rise and run.
The triangles prove the line is horizontal.
questions.correctAnswer: The triangles have the same rise/run ratio, so they can represent the same line slope.
questions.explanation: Compare 2/3 and 4/6. Constant slope means the ratios match, not that the triangles are the same size.

questions.questionText: A quantity changes from 10 to 22 in 3 hours. What is the rate of change?
options: 7.3 per hour
15 per hour
4 per hour
questions.explanation: Rate of change is change in output divided by change in input: (22 - 10) / 3 = 4.

questions.questionText: A line passes through (1, 2) and (4, 8). What is its slope?
questions.explanation: Slope is rise over run: (8 - 2) / (4 - 1) = 6/3, which simplifies to 2.

questions.questionText: A point (8, 6) is dilated from the origin by scale factor 0.5. What is the image point?
questions.explanation: A dilation from the origin multiplies both coordinates by 0.5.

questions.questionText: Figure A has side lengths 5 and 8. Figure B has corresponding side lengths 12 and 20. What can you conclude?
options: The side ratios are consistent, so this supports similarity.
The figures must be similar because both have two sides.
The side ratios are not consistent, so this does not prove similarity.

questions.questionText: A quantity changes from 50 to 38 in 3 minutes. What is the rate of change?
options: 12.7 per minute
-4 per minute
4 per minute
-9 per minute
questions.explanation: Rate of change is change in output divided by change in input: (38 - 50) / 3 = -4.

questions.questionText: A quantity changes from 12 to 30 in 6 weeks. What is the rate of change?
options: 5.0 per week
24 per week
2 per week
3 per week
questions.explanation: Rate of change is change in output divided by change in input: (30 - 12) / 6 = 3.

questions.questionText: A line passes through (2, 9) and (6, 3). What is its slope?
questions.explanation: Slope is rise over run: (3 - 9) / (6 - 2) = -6/4, which simplifies to -3/2.

questions.questionText: A line passes through (-1, 4) and (5, 16). What is its slope?
questions.explanation: Slope is rise over run: (16 - 4) / (5 - -1) = 12/6, which simplifies to 2.
